hooks.command: changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^src/(components|tokens|scripts)/'); if [ -n "$changed" ]; then claude -p "You are maintaining documentation for the Charter Design System. Run 'git diff HEAD' to see what changed. Then read CLAUDE.md, llms.txt, and llms-full.txt and update any that are out of date — new or changed component APIs, token names, conventions, or scripts. Only edit what actually needs changing. If the docs already reflect the changes, do nothing and exit." --allowedTools Bash,Read,Edit 2>/dev/null; fi
